reason: Both Ink Purikura Photobooth (/play/booth) and Pipeline Pachinko (/play/pachinko) are purely client-side and repository-owned Next.js App Router features using browser WebGL2/Canvas 2D, WebAudio, opt-in getUserMedia with a bundled sample portrait fallback, and deterministic TypeScript simulation/unit/Playwright E2E tests. No external APIs, secrets, database migrations, or operator-owned infrastructure are required.
